title: Do not use. Lost all spaces & containers
text: You will lose all your data.  App kept asking me to logout and log back in. I followed the instructions and lost ALL my data. Storage spaces and containers, images, tags, descriptions; all gone. Hours of work down the drain. Use a more reliable app vendor who stores your information locally and doesn’t force you to use their cloud storage or pay exorbitant fees. They are also now charging for exports, AI scans, smart search, etc. very expensive monthly fees. Unreasonable fees. Don’t rely on this app and invest hours of your time and have your data held hostage. Or you may lose all your information at the whim of an update.

title: Superb!
text:
We were so tired of tripping over everything in our garage; annoyed with buying additional items because we could never remember what closet or drawer my wife stuffed things in when company was coming over.  New Year’s goal was to get everything organized.  We got some new storage bins, a label printer…and this app.  

What a world of difference!  We tested a few alternatives before coming across this one and there’s no comparison.  The AI and user interface are perfect.  We have everything cataloged and the QR codes we stuck on the bins make it easy to go directly where we need to go. 

Had one small issue with the QR codes but SnapFind support was incredibly responsive and gracious in helping me. You won’t find better than this.

title: Need a Subscription for Productive Use
text:
After a lot of research I found this app. I chose it because it was a “no subscription” app and the AI function is a game changer. However, after I added 3 storage containers I was prompted to “Upgrade” my purchase if I wanted to 1. use the AI capability over 30 times, 2. have more than 500 entries, and 3. save/download my inventory. 

The app IS very easy to use so I will continue to use it, especially because I’ve already started the process. 

Additional notes:
-the app crashes EVERYtime I attempt to edit a title. 
-cannot delete a QR Code from an assigned box to reassign it. I deleted the app/data from my phone and started over.  The QR Code remains “assigned” but no longer appears in the app. I could use it on another box but I don’t see it in the app. 

I’m hoping that after I “Upgrade” for $30 (per year) I will have more control over editing.
